deep_dive.summary: larksuite/cli is gaining traction with 5,719 stars. The official Lark/Feishu CLI tool, maintained by the larksuite team — built for humans and AI Agents. Covers core business domains including Messenger, Docs, Base, Sheets, Calendar, Mail, Tasks, Meetings, and more, with 200+ commands and 19 AI Agent Skills.. This represents a significant trend in Go tooling for production systems. FDEs should understand whether this is a flash-in-the-pan or a genuine shift in how teams build AI systems.
deep_dive.fde_takeaway: Evaluate larksuite/cli for client relevance. If it solves a real problem, early expertise = premium positioning. If not, you save clients from chasing hype.
